# grouper_subject (Data Source)

Looks up a Grouper subject by id or identifier (e.g. a login name). Returns only non-sensitive reference attributes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a subject by login identifier (e.g. a username or NetID) or subject id; Grouper resolves either.
data "grouper_subject" "person" {
  subject_id = "abc123"
  # subject_source_id = "sourceId" # optional, to disambiguate

  # Request extra attributes (opt-in; values land in `attributes`).
  # Attribute names depend on how subject sources are configured in your Grouper.
  subject_attribute_names = ["email", "description"]
}

output "canonical_subject_id" {
  value = data.grouper_subject.person.id
}

output "email" {
  value = data.grouper_subject.person.attributes["email"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `subject_id` (String) Subject id or login identifier (e.g. a username or NetID) to look up. Grouper resolves either.

### Optional

- `subject_attribute_names` (List of String) Subject attributes to retrieve, by their Grouper attribute names. Names depend on your subject source configuration (e.g. "email", "name", "description"). Requested values are returned in `attributes`. Only request what you need: these values are written to Terraform state, which should be treated as sensitive.
- `subject_source_id` (String) Optional subject source id to disambiguate when the same id exists in multiple sources.

### Read-Only

- `attributes` (Map of String) Map of the requested subject attributes (from `subject_attribute_names`) to their values. Empty when no attributes are requested.
- `id` (String) Canonical Grouper subject id (may differ from the supplied identifier).
- `name` (String) Subject display name.
- `source_id` (String) Resolved subject source id.
